name: tendra
description: A private SaaS tool used only by suppliers — the companies that bid on public tenders — to discover the right tenders, see what competitors won at, prepare compliant bids, and never miss a deadline.

scriptsDescriptions.worker: Run the BullMQ worker process that consumes the fetch, normalize and document queues.
scriptsDescriptions.worker:dev: Same worker process under nodemon, for editing job handlers.
scriptsDescriptions.backfill: Resume a historical archive seed from its Redis page checkpoint, on its own queue and process.
scriptsDescriptions.backfill:start: Begin a fresh historical seed, walking listing pages newest-first (--from/--to bound the range).
scriptsDescriptions.reindex: Rebuild source_payloads from object storage after a schema drop, so the archive never has to be re-crawled.
scriptsDescriptions.normalize:replay: Requeue the latest stored detail payload for every tender, re-normalizing from storage after a parser fix.
scriptsDescriptions.scheduler: Upsert the repeatable sweep and refresh schedules into Redis and exit — a deploy step, not a daemon.
scriptsDescriptions.documents:backfill: Fetch the invitation archive for tenders that never got one, filling in CPV codes and buyer tax IDs.
scriptsDescriptions.documents:manifests: List the files inside every stored invitation archive that has no manifest yet. Reads storage only (each ZIP's central directory), never the source.
scriptsDescriptions.cpv:backfill: Fill every stored tender's CPV code list from its stored armeps.am page or e-auction invitation archive. Dry run unless --apply; reports the alerts the codes would have raised and raises none.
scriptsDescriptions.notices:backfill: Fill listing_notices from every gnumner invitation-listing page already in storage — the notices swept before the chain recorded them. Reads storage only, raises nothing.
scriptsDescriptions.notices:replay: Read stored gnumner contract and failed-procedure notices again through their production retry handlers, and paper invitations through normalize.tender with the notices that uploaded them, from storage with no request (--kind=contract,failed,invitation, --unmatched=<reason>, --ref=<ids>). For a parser or converter that improved.
scriptsDescriptions.telegram:webhook: Register or clear the Telegram webhook URL with the Bot API (--set <url> | --delete | --info).
scriptsDescriptions.relevance:backtest: Replay the relevance ranking at a past cut-off for every supplier in the ledger and report where their real bids landed (--cutoff, --months, --min-history). Prints numbers, asserts nothing.
scriptsDescriptions.sources:verify: Check the source merge rules on real data: per source, tenders created and linked and unmatched results by reason, unreadable files by notice kind and extension, tenders by channel and status, gnumner's e-auction notices against tenders held, and PPCM against the e-auction ledger (--from/--to). Reads the database and storage, writes nothing; prints numbers, asserts nothing.
scriptsDescriptions.checklist:try: Run the AI checklist extractor against one invitation archive and print the result. No database, storage or queue — for prompt iteration.
